mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DRAFT' AND retired_at IS NULL) AS draft_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REVIEWED' AND retired_at IS NULL) AS reviewed_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND retired_at IS NULL AND available_on <= #{today}) AS available_published_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND retired_at IS NULL AND available_on > #{today}) AS scheduled_published_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND retired_at IS NOT NULL) AS retired_published_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'REVIEWED') AND retired_at IS NULL AND available_on <= #{today} AND created_at <= #{pendingBefore}) AS overdue_pending_count, MIN(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'REVIEWED') AND retired_at IS NULL AND available_on <= #{today} AND created_at <= #{pendingBefore}) AS oldest_overdue_pending_at FROM quiz_sets
mapper.sql: WITH available_pool AS ( SELECT id FROM quiz_sets WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND retired_at IS NULL AND available_on <= #{today} ), active_users AS ( SELECT u.id, u.login_name, u.display_name FROM app_users u WHERE u.enabled = TRUE AND (u.last_login_at >= #{activeSince} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts recent WHERE recent.user_id = u.id AND recent.completed_at >= #{activeSince} )) ), assignment_counts AS ( SELECT a.user_id, COUNT(pool.id) AS assigned_pool_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE qs.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.study_date <= #{today} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts attempt WHERE attempt.user_id = a.user_id AND attempt.quiz_set_id = a.quiz_set_id )) AS unstarted_set_count FROM user_quiz_assignments a JOIN active_users u ON u.id = a.user_id JOIN quiz_sets qs ON qs.id = a.quiz_set_id LEFT JOIN available_pool pool ON pool.id = qs.id GROUP BY a.user_id ), user_inventory AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.login_name, u.display_name, totals.pool_count - COALESCE(a.assigned_pool_count, 0) AS unassigned_set_count, COALESCE(a.unstarted_set_count, 0) AS unstarted_set_count, totals.pool_count - COALESCE(a.assigned_pool_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.unstarted_set_count, 0) AS remaining_set_count FROM active_users u CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM available_pool) totals LEFT JOIN assignment_counts a ON a.user_id = u.id )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_user_count, MIN(remaining_set_count) AS minimum_remaining_sets, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE remaining_set_count < #{warningThreshold}) AS low_stock_user_count FROM user_inventory
SELECT user_id, login_name, display_name, unassigned_set_count, unstarted_set_count, remaining_set_count FROM user_inventory ORDER BY remaining_set_count, user_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS success_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failure_count, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - created_at)) * 1000) FILTER (WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS average_latency_ms FROM ai_api_calls WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{until}

SELECT COALESCE(error_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS error_code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ai_api_calls WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{until} AND status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY COALESCE(error_code, 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY count DESC, error_code

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('READY', 'PUBLISHED', 'FAILED')) AS completed_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(attempt_count - 1, 0)), 0) AS retry_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE error_message ILIKE '%DIVERSITY%' OR error_message ILIKE '%duplicate%') AS duplicate_rejected_count, AVG(validation_score) FILTER (WHERE validation_score IS NOT NULL) AS average_validation_score FROM generation_logs WHERE created_at >= #{from}

SELECT days.challenge_date::DATE AS challenge_date, COUNT(qs.id) FILTER (WHERE qs.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published_count, #{requiredCount} AS required_count FROM generate_series(#{from}::DATE, #{until}::DATE, INTERVAL '1 day') AS days(challenge_date) LEFT JOIN quiz_sets qs ON qs.challenge_date = days.challenge_date::DATE GROUP BY days.challenge_date::DATE ORDER BY days.challenge_date::DATE
SELECT id AS generation_log_id, target_date, status, error_message, updated_at FROM generation_logs WHERE status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT aal.id AS audit_log_id, au.login_name AS actor_login_name, aal.action, aal.target_type, aal.target_id, aal.created_at FROM admin_audit_logs aal LEFT JOIN app_users au ON au.id = aal.actor_user_id ORDER BY aal.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id AS operation_event_id, event_type, status, message, started_at, completed_at FROM operation_events WHERE event_type = #{eventType} ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_briefs WHERE status = 'READY'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_sources WHERE verified = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_events (event_type, status, message) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{status}, #{message})
